author: suburbandad_
content:
I wasn't even considering a second preimage that encodes another trie to the same state root.  As you said, if keccak were so broken, invalid depth nodes would be the least of our concern (!).

I am inclined to drop the eager trie walk, in favor of only reject on invalid nodes read, and unread nodes have no bearing on accept/reject.
